description: This file defines the interface for IShell, a core component in the WPEFramework PluginHost system. It includes nested interfaces, enums, and a class for job dispatching, along with methods for plugin management, web server control, and inter-process communication.

classes.name: IShell
classes.description: Interface representing the shell controlling plugin lifecycle, communication, and system interactions within WPEFramework.

classes.name: IShell::ICOMLink
classes.description: Interface for managing inter-process COM link connections and notifications.

classes.name: IShell::INotification
classes.description: Interface for notifications related to dangling or revoked connections.

classes.name: IShell::Job
classes.description: Dispatch class for scheduling activation or deactivation jobs for plugins.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a new Job instance for a given shell, target state, and reason.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Executes the job, activating or deactivating the plugin based on the stored state and reason.

methods.name: EnableWebServer
methods.description: Enables the web server for the plugin at a specified URL path and file system path.

methods.name: DisableWebServer
methods.description: Disables the web server for the plugin.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name of the platform.

methods.name: Background
methods.description: Indicates if the plugin host is running in daemon mode.

methods.name: Accessor
methods.description: Returns an identifier for connecting to the webbridge.

methods.name: WebPrefix
methods.description: Returns the web prefix used in URL routing.

methods.name: Locator
methods.description: Returns the name of the binary that holds the plugin code.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the plugin.

methods.name: Versions
methods.description: Returns supported JSONRPC interface versions.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the instantiation name of the plugin.

methods.name: PersistentPath
methods.description: Returns the persistent storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: VolatilePath
methods.description: Returns the volatile storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: DataPath
methods.description: Returns the data storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: ProxyStubPath
methods.description: Returns the path for proxy/stub files.

methods.name: SystemPath
methods.description: Returns the system path.

methods.name: PluginPath
methods.description: Returns the plugin directory path.

methods.name: SystemRootPath
methods.description: Returns or sets the system root path.

methods.name: Startup
methods.description: Returns the startup state of the plugin.

methods.name: Startup (setter)
methods.description: Sets the startup state of the plugin.

methods.name: Substituted
methods.description: Performs variable substitution in input string.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Gets or sets whether the plugin is resumed.

methods.name: HashKey
methods.description: Returns a hash key for the plugin.

methods.name: ConfigLine
methods.description: Gets or sets the plugin configuration line.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific version is supported.

methods.name: SubSystems
methods.description: Accesses the plugin's subsystems.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Sends a notification message to subscribers.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current plugin state.

methods.name: QueryInterfaceByCallsign
methods.description: Queries for an interface by callsign.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with a specified reason.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the plugin with a specified reason.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Marks the plugin as unavailable.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates the plugin for a specified timeout.

methods.name: Reason
methods.description: Returns the current reason for plugin state.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a JSON response to the main process.

methods.name: COMLink
methods.description: Provides access to the COM link interface.

methods.name: Register (overload for RPC::IRemoteConnection::INotification)
methods.description: Registers a remote connection notification sink.

methods.name: Unregister (overload for RPC::IRemoteConnection::INotification)
methods.description: Unregisters a remote connection notification sink.

methods.name: Register (overload for ICOMLink::INotification)
methods.description: Registers a COM link notification sink.

methods.name: Unregister (overload for ICOMLink::INotification)
methods.description: Unregisters a COM link notification sink.

methods.name: RemoteConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a remote connection by ID.

methods.name: EnablePersistentStorage
methods.description: Enables persistent storage with permissions and ownership.

methods.name: EnableVolatileStorage
methods.description: Enables volatile storage with permissions and ownership.

methods.name: Root
methods.description: Template method to get root interface of a specific type.

methods.name: QueryInterfaceByCallsign (template)
methods.description: Template method to query interface by callsign.
